headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 3, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBI, and 4 at-bats. In other action, the Seattle Mariners edged out the Minnesota Twins 4-3, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including PJ Poulin of the Washington Nationals, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left flexor strain. Jake Fraley of the Tampa Bay Rays was placed on the 60-day injured list with a hernia, while Lenyn Sosa of the Toronto Blue Jays was placed on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion.

The New York Mets made a significant trade, sending RHP Freddy Peralta to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre. The Chicago Cubs also traded RHP Jameson Taillon to the Toronto Blue Jays for a player to be named later.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBI, and 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Chicago White Sox 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the charge at the plate. Sanoja hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs, while Jonathan Pintaro pitched 2 scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Orioles 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles in a one-sided matchup, securing an 8-0 victory. Impact hitters Bryce Harper, Alec Bohm, Justin Crawford, and Bryan De La Cruz led the charge for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, marking their loss in the matchup. Impact players on the field included Matt Olson, who contributed to the Braves' win, and Mike Yastrzemski, who had a notable performance for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Make Midseason Move**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets traded RHP Freddy Peralta to the Tampa Bay Rays on August 2, 2026, in exchange for RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre.
